notes.title: The demo version of Rewinder 2 is now live
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,
The demo version of Rewinder 2 is now live! We have received numerous feedback from our Septermber internal tests, thanks for everyone who wrote us feedback. Many of them have been addressed. We can't wait to show you our new demo in this Steam Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204560/2/

As we mentioned before, Rewinder 2 has undergone many changes. 
The game perspective has shifted from 2D side-scrolling to top-down view, 
adding more puzzle-solving gameplay and incorporating elements of exploration and combat. 
We hope to bring you a fresh experience while maintaining the core "Rewinding" mechanism.

Although we have made several improvement, the game is still under development. 
We welcome all feedback. Please help us make it better! You can reach us at Discord/X/QQ.
Chinese players can directly send us feedback via a QA from.

For players who wish to use a controller to play the game, please disable Steam Input otherwise there maybe issues with keybindings. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000767/0c6dcb443ee3561e449ff092e2becfb00b7e8d27.png

If you are interested, please wishlist the game, this is very important to us!
Thank you all for your support, and happy rewinding!

notes.title: Major update - Controller support and Japanese localization
notes.notes:
Hello rewinders,

We've been paying close attention to your needs for controller support, and now we're happy to announce that we've fully adapted and optimized for controller players. Also, we are preparing for Steam Deck compatibility check.

It's worth mentioning that The Rewinder is available on Nintendo Switch today. In order to ensure the same language support on both ends, Japanese localization is also included in this update. And we hope our Japanese players can enjoy Chinese unique ghost and demon culture.

Last but not least, thank you for all the support and comments all these time!

notes.title: DLC - Root of Evil is out now！English update next week
notes.notes:
Dear Rewinders,

First of all, we want to thank you for your support. It's been almost 5 months since we launched The Rewinder, and we are so grateful to every one of you that bought, played and reviewed our game.

Since the launch, we've been hard at work making our DLC "Root of Evil", to be released today! 

Unfortunately, because of some adjustments we had to make, we need to delay the English launch for the DLC for a few days.

We sincerely apologize for the delay in English localization. The Rewinder is inspired by the stories and mythologies we grew up with, and we hope to share it with people across the globe. It's been a challenge but also a fun experience trying to come up with terms to explain Taoist mythologies in English. That's why we want to spend more time and care to make sure the English version is easy to understand and fully polished.

The localization team are hard at work, and we are planning to patch the English version next week. We will inform you via annoucement once ready. Meanwhile, you can buy "The Rewinder" (-30% off) and the OST (-50% off)  at a new historically low discount. So if you are interested, you can buy the fully localized base game now and wait for the DLC English update!

Once again, we are sorry for the delay, and thank you for supporting The Rewinder!

notes.title: 1.27.0 English localization update & other patch notes
notes.notes:
A major localization update! We asked a native speaker to polish all English texts: Major thanks to Dana who did tons of edits, obsessed over typos and display issues, and wrote some brand-new poems for the flower hints! 

So if you had hesitations about the translation quality before, we hope this update will improve the experience for English players. If you catch any other localization problems in the English version, be sure to let us know.

Other small bug fixes and improvements:


 Fixed some issues of characters bouncing from the ground in certain scenes
 Added an exit button to the "stone" screens in the cave
 Fixed some camera issues
 Fixed some issues with display ratios



 Improved "petting the dog" animation!
 Added a hint for autosaving
 Improved the hint for QTE
 Improved mouse navigation for the mountain maze puzzle
 Improved the background display for the mountain scene
 You can now use esc to exit puzzle screens
 You can now drag to use inventory objects

notes.notes:
Mac users can now unlock new achievements - for players who have already finished the game, you should be able to get most story achievements retroactively just by loading into the karma stone scene. A few achievements that requires you to perform a certain action (such as "petting the dog") might require replaying to unlock.
 Fixed menu page animations.
 Fixed the issue of the "Mr. Black" clause not unlocking in the book.
 Fixed the issue of Ming's character shaking in the secret ending.
 Fixed the issue of some players getting stuck in the portal.
 Improved tutorial for the spider cave puzzle.


P.S. Players reported the issue of cloud save not working. We are aware of the issue and are currently working to fix it. Meanwhile if you need to find your local save file, you can do so here: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\MistyMountainStudio\Rewinder

And another note: By VERY POPULAR demand, we now updated the OST to include the villagers's orchestra music - "Awaken the Heavens". Players who already own The Rewinder Original Soundtrack should be able to see it after an update. We also added WAV files for all the tracks if you are looking for higher sound quality!

notes.title: The Rewinder Release Date Moved Up to September 10th
notes.notes: Hi everyone! We have a small announcement to make in regards to our release date - don't worry, it's not what you think! We are actually pushing it up to September 10th, 3pm (GMT+8). And it's *definitely not* because Qi Yun's eager to get that sweet, sweet gold - if anything, it's because he's very excited to perform his duties as a rewinder - and of course, get to meet you, our dear players. So stay tuned to join Qi Yun on his adventures on September 10th, and we'll keep you updated!
